endorsements.name: Andrzej Olchawa
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-54342
endorsements.description: Eclipse Equinox OSGi versions 3.8 through 3.18 contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the console interface that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting the fork command functionality. Attackers can establish a telnet connection to the OSGi console, perform a telnet handshake, and send fork commands to download and execute malicious Java code, establishing a reverse shell connection.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

endorsements.name: Andrzej Olchawa
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-54344
endorsements.description: Eclipse Equinox OSGi 3.7.2 and earlier contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands by sending payloads to the console interface. Attackers can connect to the OSGi console port and send base64-encoded bash commands wrapped in fork directives to achieve code execution and establish reverse shell connections.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)
